problem_statement: Provisioned resources alone do not make a gateway-managed model usable from Foundry.
hypothesis: An engineer can configure a project-scoped connected model using managed identities, invoke GPT-5.4 through APIM from Foundry, and correlate the response with successful gateway backend evidence.
customer_scenario: Engineers testing Foundry connected models through APIM and pure model calls via OpenAI SDK, HTTPS, or Azure AI Projects SDK using file-supplied settings. All five direct examples have recorded user-run Entra evidence; key handling, settings preservation, and retained project access were source-reviewed. Live API-key authentication was not tested.
data_requirements: A harmless connectivity prompt with a unique marker for the gateway test, or an original short poem prompt for each chosen direct API example. No customer data or evaluation dataset.
security_notes: APIM permits the project identity and an optional explicit Entra user, retaining tenant/audience validation and managed-identity backend/telemetry access. This deployment remains key-free; the direct client can read an external gateway key from ignored .env settings. No policy bypass or body/token logging. Responses requires the applicable feature flight. GlobalStandard inference may process outside Sweden.
setup_time_estimate: 5-10 minutes for local setup; Azure provisioning time varies, especially APIM.
